articles.title: GAME DAY: Golden Knights vs. Preds, October 13
Golden Knights at Predators projected lineups

away.summary: The Sharks are coming off a 3-2-0 start and are projected to start Yaroslav Askarov in net. No injuries or scratches are reported for San Jose in the provided articles, with the Bruins-Sharks preview noting no injuries for either team.

returning: : Jayden Struble made his Preds debut on Saturday in Ottawa and impressed with six hits in over 19 minutes of ice time.
home.summary: The Predators (2-1-2) are hosting the Sharks after a four-point road trip through eastern Canada. They recently acquired Jayden Struble from Montreal, who debuted Saturday and is now paired with Adam Wilsby. Goaltender Justus Annunen and forwards Mavrik Bourque (upper-body) and William Trudeau (upper-body) are injured, while Juuse Saros is projected to start in net.
